name: strategic-foresight-viz
description: Create strategic foresight and futures-analysis diagrams through draw.io MCP. Use for PESTLE scans, trend matrices, weak-signal maps, scenario planning, futures cones, and VUCA/CATUR assessments. Selects from 24 foresight techniques. Route hypothesis, organizational, and decision-analysis visuals such as ACH, Cultural Web, and Pre-Mortem to intana-viz.
